name: Dynamic Query Synonym Expansion via Relational Thesaurus
description: When a customer searches for 'sofa', they also expect to see listings titled 'couch' or 'settee'. Expanding queries using a synonym thesaurus bridges terminology gaps.
prompt:
When a customer searches for 'sofa', they also expect to see listings titled 'couch' or 'settee'. Expanding queries using a synonym thesaurus bridges terminology gaps.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: item_id, description, matched_alias.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Expand search term 'sofa' with all relational synonyms and match inventory
            WITH expanded_terms AS (
                SELECT 'sofa' AS search_term
                UNION
                SELECT synonym FROM synonym_thesaurus WHERE base_term = 'sofa'
            )
            SELECT 
                f.item_id,
                f.description,
                t.search_term AS matched_alias
            FROM furniture_items f
            JOIN expanded_terms t 
              ON f.description ILIKE ('%' || t.search_term || '%')
            ORDER BY f.item_id;
why_it_fails: Hardcoding synonyms into client-side application code makes vocabulary updates inflexible.
